paper: Zhang, Liu & Zhang (2012), arXiv:1211.0762, 'Spin-orbital Texture in Topological Insulators'
replication_type: independent reimplementation from equations (Eqs. 1-10), not author code

model.note_on_warping: Task title mentions 'hexagonal warping', but arXiv:1211.0762 does NOT include a hexagonal warping (Fu C3v k^3) term. The paper's core physics is the p-orbital-resolved spin-orbital texture built from the first-order-in-k basis wavefunctions (Eqs.2-5), evaluated on a circular Fermi contour. We replicated the actual paper.
model.wavefunctions: |Phi+/-> expanded in {px,py,pz} x {spin up,down} to first order in k [Eqs.4,5]; params u0,v0,u1,v1,w1 real; single effective orbital (alpha-sum dropped, rescales magnitudes only); hbar*vf=1.

pz_spin_texture_vs_Eq(unnumbered p4).status: EXACT: [Dpz,x,Dpz,y,Dpz,z]=+/-(u0-/+v1 k)^2[sin,-cos,0]; left-handed upper / right-handed lower reproduced

orbital_char_diff_2theta_vs_text_Eq(p5).status: EXACT: Dpx0-Dpy0 = -/+2cos(2theta)(v0-/+k u1)k w1; confirms 2theta (pi-period) angular dependence

total_inplane_spin_angular_form.status: EXACT angular form [-sin,cos]; right-handed for BOTH upper and lower cones -> confirmed

total_inplane_spin_prefactor.status: CONVENTION GAP: our prefactor = 2*(v0-/+k u1)k w1 vs paper's 4*(...); exact factor-2, constant across k and theta. Direction/handedness identical; magnitude prefactor differs (alpha-sum cross-term / Pauli-vs-spin convention). Physics unaffected.

Ppx_signs.status: CONFIRMED: upper Dirac cone = tangential orbital texture, lower = radial; transition at Dirac point

qualitative_claims_confirmed: Spin-momentum locking: helical spin texture perpendicular to k (pz orbitals): left-handed upper cone, right-handed lower cone.
px/py orbital spins do NOT wind like pz: they follow [sin,cos] form (Eqs.7,8) with 2theta amplitude modulation.
Radial pr couples to left-handed spin, tangential pt to right-handed spin (upper cone); opposite for lower cone.
Tangential orbital texture dominant for upper cone, radial for lower cone; total in-plane orbital spin is right-handed for BOTH cones.
Ppx polarization changes sign across the Dirac point (tangential->radial transition).

verdict.core_physics_reproduced: spin-momentum locking + coupled spin-orbital texture (pz helical, px/py 2theta orbital texture, tangential-upper/radial-lower, right-handed in-plane orbital spin, Ppx sign flip)
verdict.summary: Independent from-equations build reproduces every analytic prediction of the paper's effective k.p model to machine precision (Eqs. pz-texture, 7, 8, orbital-diff 2theta, 10) and all qualitative spin-orbital-locking claims. One constant factor-2 prefactor discrepancy in the total in-plane spin magnitude (angular form & handedness exact).

honest_gaps: No hexagonal warping term implemented because the paper does not contain one; only the isotropic Dirac cone (Eq.1) + orbital-resolved wavefunctions. If the task intended the Fu-warping model (PRL 2009), that is a DIFFERENT paper.

alpha (atom/orbital) sum collapsed to one effective orbital: absolute magnitudes are convention-dependent; only ratios/angular-forms/signs are meaningful. Likely source of the total-in-plane factor-2.
Eqs.7,8 are the paper's stated small-k limit; verified in that limit (err ~4e-5 at k=1e-4).
No ab-initio (VASP) comparison done; compared analytic effective-model predictions only, as intended for a k.p replication.
